suggestions.quote: She counts what her savings will buy. Last month, a year of flour. Tonight, half a year. She didn't spend a cent.
suggestions.fix: Either change line 284 from "Flour man: Triple." to "Flour man: Double." so that a year of flour halved matches the price multiplier, or update line 305 to "Tonight, four months." (or "a third of a year.") and line 307 to "Lotte: A third." to resolve the arithmetic slip.

suggestions.quote: A king, a chessboard (c05). One grain on the first square, and double on every square after. By the last square, the board owes more wheat than the whole world grows in over a thousand years (c11).

keep.quote: Ask people to carry on a doubling, and most guess far too low (c08). You just did. In public. With a band.
